snippet.title: Longplay of Mickey's Wild Adventure
snippet.description:
Longplay of Mickey's Wild Adventure, played as the PAL version on the PlayStation. This game's version was released in Mar. 1996. Tell us what you think by leaving a comment down below!

00:00 - Start
01:20 - Steamboat Willie (Nov. 18th, 1928)
05:08 - The Mad Doctor (1933)
13:46 - Moose Hunters (1937)
17:03 - The Lonesome Ghosts (1937)
22:16 - Mickey and the Beanstalk (1947)
29:29 - The Prince and the Pauper (1990)
44:24 - Final boss
47:17 - Credits
